context:
Goal: main stays stable while 70 or more asks run at once, at the most outcome speed (restart-plan.md:766-767).
Problem (rule): merging onto a red main is what decision no-merge-onto-red-main stops; letting some lanes merge changes it, so it needs your word.
Based on (ruling): no-merge-onto-red-main.md:5 refuses a merge while main's newest completed run is red; line 23 records Oct 13-14, 14 red runs in a row.
Based on (read): bisect and revert land in #3152's act 3 (its design, line 7), so the blamed path is not known today.
Based on (measured): a full CI run takes 33 to 38 min (restart-plan.md:268).
Departs from: main — every merge halts while main is red; this lets lanes off the blamed paths merge.
Meanwhile: main keeps the halt; #3152 builds the blame step either way. Item 745 asks the separate question of when merges resume.

options.gain: No defect can hide under a new merge.
options.how: Main keeps what it does today.
options.label: Halt all merges while main is red (recommended)
options.lose: Every lane waits a full CI run, 33 to 38 min, even when its files are unrelated.

options.how: The merge tool lets a lane merge when none of its files are on the blamed paths. Decision no-merge-onto-red-main changes.
options.label: Let lanes off the blamed paths merge
options.lose: Until the bisect exists the blame is a guess, so a bad merge can slip through.
